# Signs and Arts

> Signs and Arts (signsandarts.in) is an Indian manufacturer and online seller of ready-made LED sign boards and signage, based in Hyderabad, Telangana. We make medical, clinic, pharmacy, dental, optical, bar, retail and custom LED sign boards, plus 12V pixel LEDs and accessories. All boards are double-sided, weatherproof, plug-and-play (230V), with COD and pan-India delivery.

Contact: +91 93928 78946 | hello@signsandarts.in | Hyderabad, Telangana 500060
